test_inputs.explanation: The order_id '192' was extracted from the URL pattern '/admin/sales_order/view/order_id/192/' which appears repeatedly in the agent's navigation. The other values (comment, status, notify_customer, visible_on_frontend) are reasonable defaults for a Magento order status update operation, as the agent spent significant time on the order detail page (steps 3-10) suggesting they were performing an update action, though specific values weren't visible in the summary.
